name: The Coffee Bean & Tea Leaf - Century Square
description:
MUST TRY: The Original Mocha, Double Chocolate, Black Forest, Iced Tea Latte. The Coffee Bean & Tea Leaf offers some of the best Coffees and Teas, serving a tantalising collection of drinks that are suitable for family, large groups, catching up with friends and colleagues. This cafe is located at Century Square (nearest train station: Tampines MRT Station). From trend-setting drinks like the World Famous Ice Blended to the employees who become a part of the communities they work in, The Coffee Bean & Tea Leaf has discovered the formula for a successful coffee and tea company. 
Source: hungrygowhere.com
